title: Built once, kept running
summary: How this layer runs, split the way its h2 is: BUILT ONCE is one short line (Diagnose · Architect · Install to the Handover datum, with one sentence of what is built and handed over); KEPT RUNNING hangs from the handover — a drop line lands on Calibrate, the runbook's standing page of what is checked each month and each quarter.
story: After the rules sheet (what you hold) comes who keeps the machine running. The build is told once, briefly; the weight goes to what never stops — the monthly and quarterly checks your operator runs from the runbook, or we run on retainer. It is the page's one section that is not a row list (the ledger and the rules table sit above it).
copy: [N] the build line: 01 Diagnose · 02 Architect · 03 Install · Datum Handover

[N] the build sentence (condenses the four [N] phase outputs): “Diagnosed from the channel orchestration map, architected with your RevOps lead, and installed in your stack at low volume before it scales. At handover you hold the ICP & Signal Map, the Orchestration Rules and the runbook, and your operators are trained.”
[N] Calibrate: “Placement, data decay and routing tuned as signals shift.”

[R from today's Phase II] (FC scope) run-sheet: Each month — Inbox placement and domain reputation watched; incidents handled · The data pipeline refreshed, decayed records cleared. Each quarter — Routing rules retuned as signal patterns shift · Capacity planned ahead of demand
[N] foot “Your operator runs these from the runbook, or we do on retainer. Either way, the machine stays in your stack.”
